map.小朋友学写字，跟着动画逐笔临摹「火」「水」「永」等字，建立正确的起笔、行笔、收笔: Children learning to write can trace characters like huo (fire), shui (water), and yong stroke by stroke along the animation, building correct starting, moving, and ending order, avoiding reversed strokes.
map.成年人练书法或硬笔字，核对易错字笔顺（如「万」先横折钩后撇、「及」先撇后横折折撇: Adults practicing calligraphy or penmanship can verify error-prone stroke orders (e.g. the character wan writes horizontal-turning-hook before left-falling; the character ji writes left-falling before horizontal-turning-left-falling), correcting long-standing mistakes.

map.演示「永」字八法笔顺: Demonstrate the stroke order of yong (the Eight Principles of Yong)
map.输入「永」（5 画）：动画依次展示 点→横折钩→横撇→撇→捺，对应「永字八法」基: Input yong (5 strokes): the animation shows, in order, dot → horizontal-turning-hook → horizontal-left-falling → left-falling → right-falling, the basic strokes of the Eight Principles of Yong; you can pause stroke by stroke to observe each direction.
map.笔顺依据什么规范？: Which standard defines the stroke order?
map.依据《现代汉语通用字笔顺规范》与通用书写习惯，覆盖常用规范汉字；生僻字或异体字可: Based on the Standard Stroke Order of Commonly Used Characters in Modern Chinese and common writing habits, covering common standard characters; rare or variant characters may be absent.
map.可以逐笔慢放或暂停吗？: Can I slow down or pause stroke by stroke?

map.笔顺和笔画数对不上字典怎么办？: What if the stroke order or count disagrees with the dictionary?
map.先确认输入的是规范简体字；若涉及繁体或异体写法，笔顺可能不同，可切换对应字形再查: First confirm you entered the standard simplified character; if a traditional or variant form is involved, the stroke order may differ — switch to the corresponding glyph and look it up again.
